biography: I am a second-year PhD student at [Michigan CSE](https://cse.engin.umich.edu/), advised by Prof. [Anhong Guo](https://guoanhong.com/). I also work closely with Prof. [Jason Wu](https://jasonwunix.com/).

I study human–computer interaction (HCI) and accessibility. In particular, I am interested in developing systems and techniques that empower people with diverse access needs to engage fully with the digital world.

news.text: I'll be at UIST 2026 in Detroit, demoing [GAM](https://programs.sigchi.org/uist/2026/program/content/276221)!
Starting my PhD journey at UM CSE!

publication_titles.general_accessibility_models_demo: General Accessibility Modeling (GAM): Understanding Accessibility Needs from Computer Use
